title: Operating the service on the build host
summary: The service is the user systemd unit alchemy-autobuild.service. v0.5.1 adds --status (runner state and recent intake), --list-pending (Git submissions that would run, without running them) and the config key git_intake (false pauses the Git inbox). Install and rollback steps for a Claude Code session, including a small model, are in docs/autobuild/INSTALL_V051_WITH_CLAUDE_CODE.md.
invariants: Prove the service on one smoke ZIP with git_intake false before Tom enables the Git inbox.
Never delete receipts, results or inbox entries to make a submission run again.
The service runs only while Tom is logged in unless lingering is enabled (loginctl show-user shows Linger=).
